inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.attach.input
inputs.description: The raw input to `attach`: an object with exactly the keys `client`, `protocol` and `resume`, and any other shape is refused. `protocol` must be the number 1, `client.kind` must be `electron`, `ios` or `test`, `client.name` must be non-blank and at most 80 characters, and `resume` must be null or `{ epoch, sequence }` with an `epoch` of 32 lowercase hex characters and a `sequence` that is a non-negative safe integer.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.projectId.input
inputs.description: The raw request input that names the project, read from its `projectId` key; an input that is not a non-array object has no such key. The value must be the string `local-` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, the form the protocol reserves for projects registered on the computer, so paths and hosted project ids are refused.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.revision.input
inputs.description: The raw request input that names the checked-out revision, read from its `revision` key; an input that is not a non-array object has no such key. That value must be an object with exactly `branch` and `commit`, where `branch` is a string of 1 to 255 characters and `commit` is a 40-character lowercase hex SHA.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.approval.input
inputs.description: The approval input: an object with exactly `agents`, `deviceId`, `pairingId` and `projectIds`, plus `comments` only when it is sent. `pairingId` must be 32 lowercase hex characters, `deviceId` must be 40 lowercase hex characters, `projectIds` must hold 1 to 64 distinct `local-` project ids, and `agents` must be a boolean; a present `comments` must be a boolean that is true whenever `agents` is true.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.pairing.input
inputs.description: An object with exactly one key, `pairingId`, whose value must be 32 lowercase hex characters; any other shape or value is refused with `invalid-message`.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.device.input
inputs.description: An object with exactly one key, `deviceId`, whose value must be 40 lowercase hex characters; any other shape or value is refused with `invalid-message`.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.attach
outputs.description: The checked attach input, returned with `protocol` always 1, a `client` whose `kind` is `electron`, `ios` or `test` and whose name is unchanged, and `resume` either null or `{ epoch, sequence }`. Only input that passed every check is returned, so a caller can rely on these shapes.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.projectId
outputs.description: The project id from the input, returned unchanged: `local-` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, the form reserved for projects registered on the computer. A path or a hosted project id is never returned.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.revision
outputs.description: The checked branch and commit, returned as `{ branch, commit }` with the branch exactly as sent. `branch` is 1 to 255 characters, and `commit` is a 40-character lowercase hex SHA.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.approval
outputs.description: The checked approval input, returned with `pairingId`, `deviceId`, `projectIds` and `agents`, plus `comments` only when the input carried it. Each value is the checked input value, unchanged, and `projectIds` keeps the order it was sent in.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.pairing
outputs.description: The checked pairing id, returned as `{ pairingId }`, and it is exactly 32 lowercase hex characters.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.device
outputs.description: The checked device id, returned as `{ deviceId }`, and it is exactly 40 lowercase hex characters.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Every refused input throws a RemoteFailure whose `code` names the failed check: `protocol-unsupported`, `invalid-message`, `project-required`, `project-denied` or `revision-required`. Its message is the fixed display text for that code and carries no input values.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.attach.input
inputs.description: The raw input to `attach`: an object with exactly the keys `client`, `protocol` and `resume`, and any other shape is refused. `protocol` must be the number 1, `client.kind` must be `electron`, `ios` or `test`, `client.name` must be non-blank and at most 80 characters, and `resume` must be null or `{ epoch, sequence }` with an `epoch` of 32 lowercase hex characters and a `sequence` that is a non-negative safe integer.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.attach
outputs.description: The checked attach input, returned with `protocol` always 1, a `client` whose `kind` is `electron`, `ios` or `test` and whose name is unchanged, and `resume` either null or `{ epoch, sequence }`. Only input that passed every check is returned, so a caller can rely on these shapes.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `protocol-unsupported` when `protocol` is a number other than 1, and with code `invalid-message` for any other refusal: a missing or non-number protocol, keys other than exactly `client`, `protocol` and `resume`, or a malformed `client` or `resume`.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.projectId.input
inputs.description: The raw request input that names the project, read from its `projectId` key; an input that is not a non-array object has no such key. The value must be the string `local-` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, the form the protocol reserves for projects registered on the computer, so paths and hosted project ids are refused.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.projectId
outputs.description: The project id from the input, returned unchanged: `local-` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, the form reserved for projects registered on the computer. A path or a hosted project id is never returned.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `project-required` when the input is not a non-array object or its `projectId` is undefined, and with code `project-denied` when it is not a string of the form `local-` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.revision.input
inputs.description: The raw request input that names the checked-out revision, read from its `revision` key; an input that is not a non-array object has no such key. That value must be an object with exactly `branch` and `commit`, where `branch` is a string of 1 to 255 characters and `commit` is a 40-character lowercase hex SHA.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.revision
outputs.description: The checked branch and commit, returned as `{ branch, commit }` with the branch exactly as sent. `branch` is 1 to 255 characters, and `commit` is a 40-character lowercase hex SHA.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `revision-required` whenever the input is not a non-array object, or `revision` is undefined or malformed: not an object with exactly `branch` and `commit`, a `branch` that is empty or longer than 255 characters, or a `commit` that is not 40 lowercase hex characters.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.approval.input
inputs.description: The approval input: an object with exactly `agents`, `deviceId`, `pairingId` and `projectIds`, plus `comments` only when it is sent. `pairingId` must be 32 lowercase hex characters, `deviceId` must be 40 lowercase hex characters, `projectIds` must hold 1 to 64 distinct `local-` project ids, and `agents` must be a boolean; a present `comments` must be a boolean that is true whenever `agents` is true.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.approval
outputs.description: The checked approval input, returned with `pairingId`, `deviceId`, `projectIds` and `agents`, plus `comments` only when the input carried it. Each value is the checked input value, unchanged, and `projectIds` keeps the order it was sent in.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `invalid-message` for any refused approval: keys that are not exactly `agents`, `deviceId`, `pairingId` and `projectIds` (with or without `comments`), a `projectIds` that is not 1 to 64 distinct `local-` ids, a non-boolean `agents`, a present `comments` that is not a boolean or is false while `agents` is true, or a malformed `pairingId` or `deviceId`.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.pairing.input
inputs.description: An object with exactly one key, `pairingId`, whose value must be 32 lowercase hex characters; any other shape or value is refused with `invalid-message`.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.pairing
outputs.description: The checked pairing id, returned as `{ pairingId }`, and it is exactly 32 lowercase hex characters.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `invalid-message` when the input is not an object with exactly the key `pairingId`, or when that value is not 32 lowercase hex characters.

inputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.device.input
inputs.description: An object with exactly one key, `deviceId`, whose value must be 40 lowercase hex characters; any other shape or value is refused with `invalid-message`.

outputs.name: RemoteInputValidator.device
outputs.description: The checked device id, returned as `{ deviceId }`, and it is exactly 40 lowercase hex characters.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Thrown as RemoteFailure with code `invalid-message` when the input is not an object with exactly the key `deviceId`, or when that value is not 40 lowercase hex characters.
